answer: Every agent that wants to trade at the wharf must first lock a refundable bond in a shared vault: the bond is small for one identity but must be posted per vertex of the interaction graph, so a sybil operator minting a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds at once. The vault releases the bond only after a quiet window with no fraud reports, and any proven duplicate forfeits its bond to the reporters. Honest agents pay once and keep trading; an attacker pays linearly per fake identity, and the cost scales faster than the profit from one scam, so mass fakery stops being worth it.
